TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION CALLOUT · AUTHENTICATION & JIT PROVISIONING ARCHITECTURE

1. GOOGLE IDENTITY & CLAIMS (01A)
• Standard Google Sign-in button renders via GIS SDK.
• Client binds 256-bit challenge nonce; backend validates against session TTL.
• Google issues RS256-signed JWT with immutable subject ID (sub).
• First-time login JIT auto-provisions citizen record with base OWNER role.
• Beneficiary privileges assigned dynamically via estate plan relations.

2. EMAIL / PASSWORD & SEC-02 HASHING (01B)
• Form inputs sanitized & validated on both Client (RFC 5322) and Backend.
• Passwords hashed with 128-bit cryptographic Salt using ASP.NET PasswordHasher.
• Strictly separates login credentials from Master KEK and Shamir shares.
• Registration enforces unique email constraint & atomic Person/User creation.
• Rate limiting & lockout protection defend against brute-force attacks.

3. SERVER-SIDE TOKEN VALIDATION & AUDIT
• Backend validates RS256 signatures dynamically via Google JWKS endpoints.
• Enforces active account verification (IsActive && !IsLocked) prior to token grant.
• Signs HMAC-SHA256 JWT Access Token with sub, person_id, email, and role.
• Mandatory append-only audit trail: writes AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS before token release.

4. EPHEMERAL RAM TOKEN STORAGE & SESSIONS
• Access Token held exclusively in React Context ephemeral RAM memory.
• Not persisted in Web Storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) to limit exposure.
• Note: Complete XSS mitigation requires strict CSP and input sanitization.
• Authenticated session mounts role-specific dashboard with optional Flow 02 jump.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION CALLOUT · DATA GOVERNANCE & CRYPTOGRAPHIC DEFINITIONS

1. WHAT DOES HASHING (SHA-256) DO?
• 1-way irreversible cryptographic digest producing a 64-hex digital checksum.
• Purpose: Data integrity verification and detection of unauthorized tampering.
• Note: Checksum supports data integrity checks; legal non-repudiation requires combined attestations and audit trail.

2. WHAT DOES ENCRYPTION & KEY HIERARCHY DO?
• Authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM) protecting file confidentiality with AAD.
• A fresh 256-bit DEK is generated per asset/version and wrapped by the Master KEK.
• Master KEK is the secret partitioned into 3 Shamir Shares (2/3 threshold). DEK is never split directly.

3. WHAT DOES CLOUDFLARE R2 STORE?
• Stores encrypted binary ciphertext blobs (.enc) in a private bucket ($0 egress).
• Holds no plaintext files and no decryption keys.
• Note: Object keys and file sizes are visible to storage administrators; sensitive metadata is kept in SQL Server.

4. WHAT DOES SQL SERVER 2022 STORE?
• Stores relational metadata, access policies, audit events, and encrypted key material.
• Stores wrapped System Share (Share 1), Nonce 12B, Auth Tag 16B, and WrappedDataKey.
• Note: Sensitive metadata (asset titles, allocation maps) is secured via database access control.

nodes.value: Swimlane workflow for survival check-ins, grace periods, independent 90-day suspension countdowns, executor wellbeing alerts, and safe data freezing. Architecture: Server Process -> DB Commit -> Client Response. Legal reference: Art. 120 Civil Code 2015 & LegacyVault SRS v3.11.0 product policies.

CLIENT · REACT WEB APP

DATABASE · SQL SERVER 2022

EXECUTOR · HANDOVER EXECUTOR

(Plan ACTIVE)

Estate plan is active;
Heartbeat monitoring begins

Select check-in cycle (30/60/90d)
& grace period (7/14/30d)

06 · Check-in: Click 'I Am Alive'
Confirm safety via Web Dashboard
or via secure Email web page

11 · Late Check-in Request
Owner signs in & pings alive
while SUSPENDED or FROZEN

SAFE DATA FREEZE
Read-only; No auto-wipe from DMS;
Ready for recovery or claim

POST /api/v1/dms/settings
Payload: {cycleDays, graceDays}

Display confirmed NextDue
& active pulse indicator

Attach Bearer JWT in RAM
or Email CheckInToken

Display Check-in Error (400/401)

Prompt user to re-authenticate

09 · Update UI: Active Pulse
Display green pulse animation;
Display new NextDue from Server
A

10 · Display Suspension Banner
Show days remaining to FreezeAt;
1-click recovery check-in button

16 · Display Frozen State UI
Lock asset mutation features;
Preserve all data per OPLAN-05

03 · Process Initial Schedule
NextCheckInDue = now + CycleDays;
Settings changes apply next cycle

Return HTTP 200 OK
Include confirmed NextDue & Schedule

DmsHeartbeatWorker (HostedService)
Hourly autonomous background audit
for all system vaults

Status == 'ACTIVE'
AND now >= NextDue?

05 · Transition to CHECKIN_PENDING
GraceExpiresAt = NextDue + GraceDays;
Queue check-in reminder email (DMS-03)

Check-in Validation:
Token valid & no death claim
approved or under review?

Flag Status = RESCUE_PENDING
Alive check-in conflicts with claim;
Notify Verifier for urgent review

08 · ACID Check-in Process
Insert CheckInLogs (with Method);
Status = 'ACTIVE'; NextDue = now+Cycle;
Close alert task: OWNER_CHECKED_IN

Return HTTP 200 OK
New NextDue returned by Server

Status == 'CHECKIN_PENDING'
AND now >= GraceExpiresAt?

10 · Transition to CHECKIN_SUSPENDED
Record suspended_at = now;
FreezeAt = GraceExpiresAt + 90 days;
Pause regular check-in countdown

Check qualified Executor
assigned (XS/XSMax)?

Dispatch ExecutorAlertTasks in DB
Remind after 48h; 72h SLA response window;
Does not control 90-day freeze timer

Validate Executor Response
Verify TaskId & authorization token

Status == 'CHECKIN_SUSPENDED'
Worker autonomous audit scan

12 · Send Staged Reminders
Countdown: Start, 30d, 7d, 24h
(Deduplicated email dispatch)

Status == 'CHECKIN_SUSPENDED'
AND now >= FreezeAt
(90 days elapsed)?

15 · Safe Freeze Transaction
Status = FROZEN_INACTIVITY;
Write AuditEvents per vault;
Lock mutations, preserve all data

COMMIT TRANSACTION:
UPDATE [Vaults] SET NextCheckInDue
& DmsSettings; Write [AuditEvents]

COMMIT TRANSACTION:
UPDATE Status='CHECKIN_PENDING',
GraceExpiresAt; Queue Reminder Email

COMMIT TRANSACTION:
INSERT INTO [CheckInLogs];
UPDATE Status='ACTIVE', LastCheckIn=now;
UPDATE Tasks='OWNER_CHECKED_IN'

COMMIT TRANSACTION:
UPDATE Status='CHECKIN_SUSPENDED',
SuspendedAt=now, FreezeAt=due+90d

INSERT INTO [ExecutorAlertTasks]
(TaskId, VaultId, ExecutorId, PENDING);
Queue Outbox Warning Email

COMMIT TRANSACTION:
UPDATE [ExecutorAlertTasks]
SET Status='NO_CERTIFICATE_AVAILABLE',
CompletedAt=now

COMMIT TRANSACTION:
UPDATE Status='FROZEN_INACTIVITY';
Write [AuditEvents] (Per Vault);
Queue Freeze Notification Email

Send Check-in Reminder Email
Link opens web check-in page
(Prevents bot scanner clicks)

Send Suspension Notice
Alert 90-day countdown to freeze
and recovery instructions

Send Executor Alert
Action required: Check on Owner;
Death NOT presumed

Deliver Staged Warning Email
Notice of remaining days to FreezeAt
(Impending data freeze)

Send Freeze Notification
Vault is safely frozen;
Data preserved, never deleted

Receive Wellbeing Alert
Check real-world status of Owner;
Handover NOT triggered

Actual verification
findings?

14a · Submit Status to Server
Record NO_CERTIFICATE_AVAILABLE;
90-day timer continues running

14b · Submit Death Claim
To FLOW 04
(Legal Verification)
